claims.value: L = CSNK2A1-WT + DMSO; M (Arg6/Lys4) = CSNK2A1-WT + 30 uM CX-4945 (silmitasertib) 4 h; H (Arg10/Lys8) = CSNK2A1-TM (V66A/H160D/I174A) + 30 uM CX-4945 4 h; all induced with 1 ug/mL tetracycline 48 h
claims.evidence: PRIDE/paper: 'FT-U2OS cells expressing wild type CSNK2A1-HA were either adapted to Light (L) or Medium (M) ... triple mutant ... Heavy (H)'; 'The WT (L, M) and TM (H) cell lines were treated with 1 ug/ml tetracycline for 48 h ... Medium WT and Heavy TM cells were treated with 30 uM CX-4945 for 4 h. Light WT cells were treated with equal volume of DMSO vehicle.' Data (Phospho (STY)Sites.txt, loc prob >=0.75): CSNK2 acidic-motif sites (S-[DE]-x-[DE]) median log2 M/L -0.59 and H/L -0.53 vs -0.18/-0.16 for other sites, so L = uninhibited DMSO. Partially rescued sites named in the paper have H/M > 0 in all replicates: EIF5B S214 +2.73, SRRM1 S874 +1.25, EIF3C S166 +1.09, DHX16 S103 +0.92, NOP56 S519 +0.76, NOP58 S502 +0.48, SSB S366 +0.47, EXOSC9 S306 +0.38, RPRD2 S374 +0.35 (LIG1 S66 -0.44 is the exception), so H = inhibitor-resistant TM and M = WT.

claims.evidence: Cellosaurus CVCL_0042: osteosarcoma of the tibia of a 15-year-old female, European ancestry (same as PXD049431); PRIDE: U2OS with Flp-In T-REx

limitations: PRIDE data-processing text says heavy labels 'Arg8 and Lys10' and the paper says MaxQuant 1.6.2.10; the deposited mqpar.xml (MaxQuant 2.0.3.0, Arg10;Lys8) and the sample protocol (Arg-10/Lys-8 heavy) are used.

MaxQuant assigns fraction 1 to phos and 3 to prot runs in separate parameter groups; these are not fractions of one sample but separate measurements (TiO2-enriched vs total) and are encoded with fraction identifier 1 and different enrichment process.
Tetracycline induction (1 ug/mL, 48 h) applies to all channels and is recorded in the genotype text, not as a treatment.
sdrf-tools reconcile agrees with the PRIDE record; Lys-C comes from the Trypsin/Lys-C mix in the protocol, MaxQuant searched Trypsin/P.
